Chain data and outside leads enter the engine. Leads are checked
Copies and relaunches are set aside first. Then every fact is read
Each coin that passes goes to PINRai as one bundle of evidence.
PINRai reads and answers in fixed plain words. Its readings are
kept and compared with what happened.
What PINRai found goes through design and the site and apps to
What happened next, rugged or held, comes back to the engine and
teaches PINRai. Corrections from the PINR team enter at the head.
